description:
Stop retyping the same things.

Snippets keeps the text you reuse—replies, email signatures, addresses, code, checklists, and templates—organized and one tap away. Search by name, content, keyword, or tag, pin favorites, then copy or share what you need.

BUILD SMARTER TEMPLATES
Use live placeholders for the date, time, or clipboard. Preview the result while you edit, so every copied snippet is ready to use.

PRIVATE WHEN IT MATTERS
Move sensitive content into a secure snippet. Its body is encrypted and requires Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode to reveal or copy. On iPhone and iPad, secure clipboard copies expire after 60 seconds.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• A fast, touch-first library and editor on iPhone
• A two-column workspace with hardware-keyboard shortcuts on iPad
• Search, multi-tag filters, pinning, and keywords
• Encrypted backup and restore
• Import, export, sharing, and links

Optional iCloud sync keeps the same library on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Records are encrypted on your device before upload.

With Snippets for Mac, short keywords can expand saved text in other apps.

Snippets is free and open source, with no ads or tracking.
promotionalText: Stop retyping. Keep reusable text one tap away, protect sensitive snippets, and sync your encrypted library across Apple devices.
